intro: Every animal built from your sheets KM-P4 and KM-P8, reviewed by the strict rules (docs/ASSET_REVIEW.md): each one from all eight sides, each of its motions animated at 24 frames, its source beside it, and sixteen checks with their results.

The motions are now the game's own code: the same gait drives the review and the game's Dog and GroundBird (World/LegGait.cs). Each animal is a relief cut from one view of its sheet; the game's camera sees its right side (the Right view).
fixed: Walks rebuilt from your recordings. Legs were one rigid piece swung from the hip: they scissored, every foot left the ground at both ends of its swing, and the body rose when it should have dropped. Every walking leg is now jointed (thigh, shin, foot), each foot planted on the ground while the body passes over it, then lifted and carried forward, the knee solved to reach it. Cats, the tanuki and the Shiba walk in four beats and run at a trot (learning D19).

Birds walk instead of bouncing. The review had bounced every bird on the spot; the game never did. Birds now step on jointed legs, their heads nodding with each step; sparrows hop with both feet, crouching, springing and tucking their feet. A peck tips the body forward on planted feet, so the beak reaches the ground and the neck never folds.

Feet are measured, not eyeballed. A new check (16) reads every foot's height through every motion: none goes below the ground, a walk always has a foot down, a peck moves no foot. Its numbers are on each animal.
The heron's legs. Its long lower legs and toes, 2 to 3 px wide on the sheet, had been dropped by the cut-out's cleanup: it stood on its ankles. Thin parts are now grown back from the figure.
Earlier in this review: legs that came off (D16), tips that vanished from behind (D17), cut-outs that lost fur and feathers (D18), the insects' wings and the swim fixed.
limits: Top, bottom, front and back of an animal built from its side come from that side picture alone: the belly and back are the side's fur stretched and mirrored. The game shows the right side.

The seven in flight (sparrow, swallow, white-eye, bulbul, dove, swallowtail, dragonfly) are built from one view: from the side each is a thin plate, its top its underside mirrored. They are a few pixels across on the phone; check 4 marks each as a known limit.
A pair of legs drawn as one (the Shiba's, the crow's, the gull's) is twinned: the far leg is a copy of the near one, set behind the body, stepping out of phase.

The squirrel running is drawn mid-leap with its legs flat along the ground, so it scurries; the game's tree squirrel moves only its tail. The sitting squirrel's 6 px gap between tail and back is closed and painted with fur.
pending: The large birds in flight (black kite, gull, crow, pigeon, heron, egret, cormorant) wait for their four-view KM-S1 sheets (KAMAKURA_BUILD Step 4b). The perched and standing ones are here.
The frog, snail, crab and starfish sit on photo backgrounds on the sheets and need their own cut-outs.
In the game: nothing is placed in a level yet; the kit's FBX files are built, and the reference-phone check comes with the first level that uses them.
